title: Sisters Get CAUGHT Stealing Over $1500 Worth Of Items
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 20th, 2023. Officers were called to Home Depot regarding a two females who got caught shoplifting over $1000 worth of items. One of the sister tried to play dumb and acted like she did not know what was going on, meanwhile the other sister said that, her sister is a regular shoplifter and this what she does for a living & that she only came along with her so she could sell the items and pay her light bill.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
